questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > Entitlement Import: After importing entitlements, navigate to Software Asset > Licensing > Entitlement Import Errors to review and resolve import issues. This is the dedicated module for addressing errors from the entitlement import process.

questions.stem: Which are valid States of Remediation Options on the Software Asset Workspace License usage view after reconciliation has been run? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > Remediation Status: Valid states for remediation options are New (E), In Progress (A), and Done (D). 'Cancelled' and 'Complete' are not standard states for remediation options in the Software Asset Workspace.

questions.stem: Which tab of the License usage view is used to reclaim software licenses that are not being used?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > License Usage View: The Removal Candidates tab is used to reclaim software licenses that are not being used. This tab lists all candidates identified by reclamation rules or remediation actions for software removal. (p29)

questions.stem: Which feature provides detailed, actionable information for software reconciliation?

options.text: Software Asset Workspace Success portal view
Software Asset Workspace Software asset analytics view
Software Asset Workspace License usage view
Software Asset Workspace License operations view
Software Asset Workspace Normalization suggestions view

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Workspace Views: The License usage view provides detailed, actionable information for software reconciliation including publisher results, product results, model results, remediation options, and removal candidates in one interface. (p15)

questions.stem: By default, which persona is responsible for ensuring that the SAM program is rolled out and executed correctly and consistently across the organization?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > SAM Personas: The SAM Process Owner is responsible for ensuring the SAM program is rolled out, executed correctly, and applied consistently across the organization. The SAM Manager handles day-to-day activities; SAM Admin handles technical configuration.

questions.stem: Which role is required to create custom license metrics?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Roles: Creating custom license metrics requires script writing capability, which necessitates the sam_developer role. sam_admin can configure settings but cannot write custom scripts; sam_developer has sys_admin-level scripting privileges. (p937)

questions.stem: What Microsoft maintenance program enables you to step up a standard version of your software to an enterprise edition?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Microsoft Licensing: Microsoft Software Assurance (SA) enables step-up licensing—upgrading from a standard edition to an enterprise edition without purchasing a full new license. This is a key benefit of the Software Assurance maintenance program. (p1033)

questions.stem: During the Source Request task, the SAM manage or administrator has what options? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Source Request: During the Source Request task for software, the SAM manager/administrator can Add Purchase Order (A) to acquire new rights or Add Allocation (E) to allocate existing rights from available entitlements. Transfer and reclaim are not options here. (p1879)

questions.stem: When importing and/or manually entering software entitlement data into SAM you find that you do not have the Publisher Part Number (PPN) for several of your entitlements. What essential information is required in order for you to successfully add these entitlement records?

options.text: Agreement type, Purchased rights, Product, Asset tag, and Vendor
Publisher, Product, Version, Edition, Platform, and Language
Publisher, Product, License type, Purchased rights, Metric group, and License metric
Version, Edition, Platform, Purchased rights, Vendor, and Contract number

questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > Entitlement Data: Without a Publisher Part Number, essential entitlement information includes Publisher, Product, License type, Purchased rights, Metric group, and License metric (C). These fields define the entitlement and drive reconciliation.

questions.stem: Which application or feature can be used in baseline Software Asset Management (SAM) Professional to import software usage data?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Usage Data: SCCM (Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager) is the baseline application for importing software usage data into SAM Professional. Other third-party sources require additional integrations beyond baseline SAM Professional. (p117)

questions.stem: What methods can you use to store contract terms with your contracts? (Choose two.)

options.text: Attach a PDF of the contract to the contract record
Add the details in the Terms and Conditions section of the contract record
Add a link m the software entitlement record to the contract details stored in another location
Add the details in the Contract section of the software entitlement record
Add a link to the contract details the Assets covered record

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Contract Terms: Contract terms can be stored by attaching a PDF of the contract (A) to the contract record or by entering details in the Terms and Conditions section (B) of the contract record. These are the two primary methods for storing contract term details. (p2276)

questions.stem: When using the ServiceNow Client Software Distribution (CSD) product in conjunction with Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) to automatically remove software and reclaim license rights in your environment which of the following is required?

options.text: The software to be removed must have been installed by SCCM
You must purchase Orchestration separately in order to revoke software and reclaim license rights using SAM Pro
The software to be removed must have been discovered by SCCM
An SCCM configuration record must be created to identify the application and the associated software discovery mode

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > CSD with SCCM: To use CSD with SCCM for automated software removal, an SCCM configuration record must be created in ServiceNow to identify the application and its associated software discovery model. This links the SAM removal action to the SCCM uninstall collection. (p200)

questions.stem: What SAM feature automatically adds the next version and downgrade rights to a software model?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Content Service: The SAM Content Service automatically adds next version and downgrade rights to software models by pushing content updates. The scheduled job 'Download software content' retrieves and applies these rights from the ServiceNow content library. (p136)

questions.stem: License Change Projection works for which of the following change types? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > License Change Projection: License Change Projection works with Normal (A) and Emergency (E) change types to project how planned infrastructure changes will affect software license compliance before the change is implemented.

questions.stem: What is the definition of Partially Normalized?

options.text: A discovery model was normalized based on publisher product version fields
A discovery model was normalized based on publisher field a one
A discovery model was normalized based on publisher and product fields only
The software discovery model has not yet competed its run through the normalization process
A discovery model normalized based on product field alone

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Normalization Status: 'Partially Normalized' means the discovery model was normalized based on publisher and product fields only—the version field was not normalized. Publisher Normalized means only the publisher field was matched. (p959)

questions.stem: Which of the following license metrics require allocations in order to maintain compliance? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > License Metrics: Per Named User (C) and Per Named Device (D) license metrics require explicit allocations to maintain compliance, as they license specific named individuals or devices. Per Core, Per Device, and Per User metrics use installation counts, not allocations.

questions.stem: When Discovery identifies installed software in your environment, what table does it automatically store this data in?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Discovery Tables: When Discovery identifies installed software, it stores the data in the Software Installation [cmdb_sam_sw_install] table. A primary key is built using Publisher, Display Name, and Version fields, and a discovery model is auto-matched. (p130)

questions.stem: What navigational functions does the Software Asset Workspace License usage view provide on the product Details tab? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Product Details Tab: The navigational functions on the Product Details tab include Filter products (C), Expand and collapse tree links (D), and Expand All (E). Remediation options and unlicensed installs are data views, not navigation functions. (p289)

questions.stem: Where can the Software Model Results, Removal Candidates, Entitlements, and Remediation Options related lists be accessed on the Software Asset Workspace after a reconciliation is run?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > License Usage View: The Software Model Results, Removal Candidates, Entitlements, and Remediation Options related lists are all accessible from the License usage view in the Software Asset Workspace after reconciliation runs. (p29)

questions.stem: Software discovery models are stored in which table?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Tables: Software discovery models are stored in the Software Discovery Model [cmdb_sam_sw_discovery_model] table. This table holds the normalized and unnormalized discovery model records matched to software installations. (p129)

questions.stem: What are Microsoft Office 365 reserved licenses used tor?

options.text: To reserve a block of licenses for a specific group of users and/or user role(s)
To convert subscription licenses to regular per device licenses
To accurately calculate annual true-up cost and total spend on a product
To convert regular per user licenses into subscription licenses

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > M365 Reserved Licenses: Microsoft Office 365 reserved licenses are used to accurately calculate the annual true-up cost and total spend on a product by accounting for reserved capacity in the reconciliation calculations. (p428)

questions.stem: Which SAM role grants a user the ability to set reclamation rules?
questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > Roles: The sam_admin role grants a user the ability to set reclamation rules, which define the criteria for identifying software candidates for removal. sam_user can view, but sam_admin has full administrative access including reclamation rule management.

questions.stem: To accurately report your true up costs during reconciliation, what must you update In your software models? (Choose two.)

options.text: License cost plus reserve license cost
License cost plus maintenance cost plus reserved license cost

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > True-Up Costs: To accurately report true-up costs during reconciliation, specify the License cost (A) or the License plus Maintenance cost in the software model. Specifying maintenance cost (D) separately allows accurate total spend calculation. (p155)

questions.stem: When creating entitlements on the Software Entitlement Form and selecting a product Publisher Part Number (PPN), what information is defaulted from the PPN? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > PPN Defaults: When selecting a Publisher Part Number (PPN) on the entitlement form, the License metric (A) and License type (C) are automatically defaulted from the PPN definition in the Content Service Library, reducing manual entry errors.

questions.stem: When creating a purchase order, which feature allows sourcing a software model from multiple providers?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Vendor Catalog Items: A software model can have multiple Vendor Catalog Items (one per vendor), enabling sourcing from multiple providers when creating a purchase order. Each vendor catalog item represents a different supplier option for the product. (p2328)

questions.stem: Using content library data to track a software model’s lifecycle phase assists which ServiceNow product to perform application rationalization?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > TPM Integration: Content library lifecycle data (GA, EOL dates) integrated in software models assists Technology Portfolio Management (TPM) to perform application rationalization by identifying aging and end-of-life products in the portfolio. (p132)

questions.stem: Which consolidated dashboard in the new SAM Professional workspace enables you to organize, evaluate and view key metrics for Microsoft Office 365 and Adobe Cloud?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > SaaS Overview Dashboard: The SaaS overview dashboard consolidates key metrics for Microsoft Office 365, Adobe Cloud, and other SaaS applications, enabling evaluation of consumption, compliance, and spend in one view. (p40)

questions.stem: During the normalization process a discovery model can be fully normalized based on which of these fields? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Normalization Fields: A discovery model can be fully normalized based on Product (A), Version (C), and Publisher (F). Partially Normalized=publisher+product only; Publisher Normalized=publisher only. Asset tag, license metric, and vendor are not normalization fields. (p959)

questions.stem: Within ServiceNow Discovery, the Identification phase determines what?

options.text: How should I classify you specifically?
What else can you tell me about yourself?
Are you there? How will I classify you?

questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > Discovery Phases: The Identification phase answers 'Have I seen you before?' by comparing discovered CI attributes against the CMDB to determine if the device is known. Exploration=what else can you tell me, Classification=how do I classify you.

questions.stem: What is unmanaged spend when viewing the Software Spend Detection Overview dashboard?

options.text: The total spend for transactions where the publisher and product are identified but there's no software model identified for the product
The total spend for transactions where the publisher, product, and software model are identified but there's no software installations identified for the product
The total spend for transactions that are not identified as an accounts payable spend or an expense spend
The total spend for transactions that are identified for an unmanaged publisher

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Software Spend Detection: Unmanaged spend is the total spend for transactions where the publisher and product are identified but there is no software model defined for the product, meaning it cannot be properly tracked in SAM. (p891)

questions.stem: Does Performance Analytics (PA) come with Software Asset Management Professional?

options.text: Only if Orchestration has also been licensed
Yes, but if you want to use it for other than SAM it requires additional licensing
No, you must license it separately

questions.explanation: [Platform] SAM > Performance Analytics: Performance Analytics comes included with SAM Professional—you get full PA functionality. It does not require a separate add-on subscription or additional licensing for non-SAM use cases.

questions.stem: What is required to manage utilization of the Software Asset Management Content Service?

options.text: The service must be opted in to and can be opted out of n the future if required
The service is automatically enabled through the baseline installation but can be opted out of if required
A script must be defied to identify what information should be shared with the Content Service
Nothing. The service is automatically enabled and cannot be opted out of
The service must be opted in to but, once enabled, it cannot be opted out of

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Content Service: Managing the SAM Content Service requires opting in through the Content Service setup page, and it can be opted out of in the future if required. It is not automatically enabled nor permanently locked once activated. (p892)

questions.stem: Which is an invalid removal justification when reviewing potential Removal candidates on the License usage view?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Removal Justifications: Valid removal candidate justifications are Low Usage, Unallocated, Unlicensed, and Restricted Software. 'Duplicate License' (D) is not a valid removal justification in ServiceNow SAM. (p309)

questions.stem: Which feature is utilized to populate software usage records automatically via Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) in releases after Tokyo?

options.text: Service Graph Connector for Microsoft SCCCM

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > SCCM After Tokyo: After the Tokyo release, the Service Graph Connector for Microsoft SCCM (B) is the recommended feature to populate software usage records from SCCM, replacing the deprecated SCCM plugin integrations. (p199)

questions.stem: From which module can an on-demand reconciliation be run?

options.text: Software Asset Workspace > Discovery > License Workbench
Software Asset Workspace > Reconciliation > License Workbench
Software Asset > Discovery > Run License Position Report
Software Asset Workspace > Reconciliation > Run License Position Report
Software Asset Workspace > Discovery > Run Reconciliation

questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > On-Demand Reconciliation: On-demand reconciliation can be run from the Software Asset Workspace > License usage view by selecting the Run Reconciliation option. This view provides both reconciliation execution and results review. (p213)

questions.stem: Which feature allows the Software Asset Manager to track performance of the application in their environment?
questions.explanation: [Zurich] SAM > Success Portal: The Success portal feature allows the Software Asset Manager to track the performance of the SAM application, monitor progress toward success goals, run health checks, and mature the SAM program with predefined maturity items. (p56)
